AccountStatsViewModelTests.With_no_facts.reason: Both rendered modes use an empty state with the current import location and no spending, year, licence, currency or largest-transaction figures. The unused Avalonia view-model zero is not a visible frontend contract.

AccountStatsViewModelTests.Licences_alon.reason: Both modes leave the empty state for four licences alone and show the friendly Steam Store label with its count.

AccountStatsViewModelTests.A_mixed_curre.reason: The original mixed-currency fixture retains gross, year, purchase, wallet and currency counts without any blended monetary total; its largest individual transaction uses its own pound symbol.

AccountStatsViewModelTests.One_symbol_pl.reason: One known symbol plus an unknown-symbol transaction retains both counts and refuses a combined amount on both surfaces.

AccountStatsViewModelTests.A_single_curr.reason: Both surfaces render the original euro gross, refunded and net values and eleven kept transactions, without a redundant single-symbol currency breakdown.

AccountStatsViewModelTests.Wallet_credit.reason: The original product, top-up and redeemed-credit fixture renders each wallet fact separately and never adds either to product spending.

AccountStatsViewModelTests.The_year_tabl.reason: Both modes render the original dated years in order and the separate undated count/amount row without moving it into a year.

AccountStatsViewModelTests.With_every_ro.reason: Both modes render only the supplied dated year when the undated count is zero.

AccountStatsViewModelTests.A_bundle_show.reason: The original three-game bundle keeps its whole $120 transaction, captured UTC page date and explicit bundle label without an inferred per-game price.

AccountStatsViewModelTests.An_absent_dat.reason: Both modes omit absent first/last date facts and preserve the count of two undated transactions.
